{{main|1968 Copa del Generalísimo}}
The '''Copa del Generalísimo 1968 final''' was the 66th final of the [[Copa del Rey|King's Cup]]. The final was played on 11 July 1968 at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium]] in [[Madrid]], and was won by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], who beat [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] 1–0.
{{-}}
